description: Freshdesk is a customer support and help desk platform from Freshworks for managing tickets, customer conversations, and self-service/support widgets. It also provides embeddable website support widgets and developer APIs for integrating with a Freshdesk account.
summary: Freshdesk exposes a tenant-specific core REST API plus browser widget integration surfaces for the Help Widget and Web Chat Widget; no public GraphQL, MCP, or standalone CLI surfaces were found on freshdesk.com.
